column1: # Software products, file formats, languages and AI tools, for every language (detect/ner_context.py, LAB-1470).
# One name per line, as it is written; matching ignores case. An NER PERSON span that is
# exactly one of these is not masked: coding agents send these words in every request
# (system prompts, skill lists, tool output), and a placeholder in their place changes the task.
# Software only. Never a word that is also a person's given name or surname on its own
# (Claude, Devin, Julia, Ruby, Grace ...): such a name may appear here only as part of a
# longer product name (Claude Code), and a test checks every single-word entry against the
# language packs' name lexicons. Companies and consumer brands go to brands.tsv instead.
